snippet.title: Bootstrap Island Major Update 3 - Weather Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Survivors, the island has changed forever! Weather now plays a crucial role in survival, dynamically shaping the world and affecting every aspect of gameplay. You’ll need to think ahead, adapt, and truly engage with the environment - every storm, every gust of wind, and every drop of rain could mean the difference between life and death.

Key Features of Major Update 3:
⛈️ 1. Dynamic Weather System – Rain, wind, and lightning now impact fire, firearms, and everything on the island. 
⚡2. The Wild Storm – A brutal survival challenge pushing players to their limits.
🐗 3. Warthogs – Aggressive and territorial, these creatures attack without warning—even during the day. A dangerous but rewarding food source!
🦎 4. Critters – Catch small lizards and frogs by hand, with weapons, or by throwing rocks. Eat them raw or cook them for a quick meal.
🌿5. Roof – Build new shelters with palm leaves to protect against rain and wind for better survival.
 
⛈️ Can you survive the storm? Play Bootstrap Island now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942110/Bootstrap_Island/

🌴Join the survivors on our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/x48uSXbUyv 

#VR #Bootstrapisland #survival
